compute.cost_note: stdlib feature extraction per document; an optional feature cache speeds reruns

do_not_use_when: the baseline has no dates (manifest date_written or date-prefixed filenames)
periods hold fewer than --min-docs-per-period documents (default 2); they are dropped

examples.description: Year-by-year drift over a dated manifest

inputs.target: a dated corpus via --manifest, --baseline-dir (date-prefixed filenames) or --periods-json

artifacts: JSON drift report (--json-out); file outputs must sit under ai-prose-baselines-private/ unless --allow-public-output

purpose: Time-drift surface. Groups date-tagged baseline documents into periods (year, quarter, month or custom), then reports per-period voiceprint summaries, a cross-period voice-distance matrix (Burrows Delta and cosine per feature family), drifting features and stable features (the durable idiolect).
use_when: deciding whether a draft's distance from the baseline is recent stylistic evolution or sudden distortion
seeing which features of your voice changed over the years and which stayed stable
producing the drift input for generate_voice_report
